independently_discovered_opportunities: Turn the V11 consent schema into a usable device-only public workflow.
Make the V12 dual-progress requirement fail closed in code and tests.

product_platform_improvements.problem: Consent-based journey orchestration was schema-only and did not help a user carry a chosen next step into another product.
product_platform_improvements.implementation: Added a fixed-choice browser-only handoff planner, deterministic integrity receipt, 60-minute consent expiry, local JSON/text downloads, and explicit no-transfer boundaries.
product_platform_improvements.before_state: D1 schema and validator only; runtime disabled.
product_platform_improvements.after_state: D2 usable device-only planner; runtime transfer and server storage remain disabled.
product_platform_improvements.benefit: Users can preserve continuity without re-entering or transmitting sensitive facts.
limitations: No automatic routing, upload, account save, provider sharing, or destination acceptance is claimed.

builder_prompt_system_improvements.problem: The owner-mandated product-and-prompt dual progress requirement was documentary rather than mechanically enforced.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.implementation: Added a deterministic validator and protected owner view that reject ordinary material release authority unless both tracks contain material changes, affected artifacts, tests, benefits, limitations, and cross-version lessons.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.before_state: A release could carry a V12 template without a product-level fail-closed dual-track validator.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.after_state: Both tracks must independently pass before ordinary material release authority can become true.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.future_build_benefit: Future builders get an executable release criterion instead of relying on a narrative assertion.
limitations: The gate validates evidence structure and internal consistency; it does not replace human judgment about protected owner decisions.

reverted_or_rejected_innovation_waves.reason: Separate authorization and mature privacy/security/storage evidence are absent.

lessons_carried_forward: A governed schema should advance to a usable local workflow when that can be done without opening prohibited runtime boundaries.
Owner missions should be represented by deterministic tests when feasible.

deferred_opportunities_with_exact_reason.opportunity: Server-side handoff storage or automatic delivery
deferred_opportunities_with_exact_reason.reason: Requires identity, encryption, retention, deletion, incident, consent revocation, destination acceptance, and owner authorization evidence.

next_innovation_opportunities: Add portal-local import adapters only after each portal independently accepts the schema.
Add a user-controlled QR representation after privacy and shoulder-surfing review.
